remarks: Charming Greenwich country compound offers an inviting, updated 1900 farmhouse with beautiful gardens on 2+ level acres. This gracious 3,264 sq. ft. home blends modern amenities with original details such as hardwood floors and high ceilings. Main level features a granite-clad kitchen open to breakfast room/lounge; dining room with French doors to the side yard; wood-beamed living room with fireplace; a library and family room with terrace access; plus, two powder rooms and a laundry room. Second floor has the primary suite with sliding barn door entrance, walk-in fitted closet and bath; plus, an en-suite bedroom; two additional bedrooms and another bath. A barn with two-car garage has a studio above. Within one hour of NYC.
